title: Question About External Tools
author: vndnua
body_snippet: I'm a little confused that arguments are passed to external tools in quotes, even though I specify them without quotes. Not all external applications are designed to accept arguments in quotes. Here’s an example to test this. I created a batch file: ``` @echo %* @pause>nul ``` I registered this batch file as an external tool, as shown in the screenshot: As a resul...
notes: 2026-11-19: Expected batch quoting. The screenshot shows %* displaying quotes added by ExternalTool.SetProcessProperties. A synthetic cmd check confirmed %~n yields the individual values; ExternalToolTests 16/16. Reply and proposed not-planned closure remain drafts.
